Median lift 1.39x, typical spacing ~46 bp between sites. In 14 profile(s) the enrichment is seen in both replicate halves and the motifs are distinguishable. Caution: dimer motif — the signal may reflect one family/shared motif rather than two distinct factors. This is a sequence-level hypothesis to test (e.g. ChIP/CUT&RUN co-binding, motif mutagenesis), not a confirmed interaction. Evidence: motif co-occurrence only (ChromBPNet not yet run for this pair).
